'''Trippet''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Funglet]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Hyphoria]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Trippet fights alongside the trainer because Zobos are just too loud and annoying. Yet for some reason, those spores seem to make things worse and have Zobos all wired up. Sometimes they even start dancing."

Trippet is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Trippet's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Hyphoria]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Trippet to increase stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.

==Trivia==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "If a Zobo gets a taste of Trippet, that's all it wants to bite. So don't put Trippet on the frontlines."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Hallucinogenic spores have started to spread of Trippet's cap as tentacle-like hyphae emerged. Prolonged exposure can bring on unusual visions."
